# Third-party code and fonts bundled in this folder

| Component | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (`pdfjs/`) | 3.11.174 | Apache-2.0 |
| [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib) (`pdf-lib/`) | 1.17.1 | MIT |
| [SortableJS](https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable) (`sortable/`) | 1.15.2 | MIT |
| [Font Awesome Free](https://fontawesome.com/license/free) (`fontawesome/`) | 6.5.0 | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT |
| [Instrument Serif](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Instrument+Serif) (`fonts/`) | via Fontsource | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| [Bricolage Grotesque](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Bricolage+Grotesque) (`fonts/`) | via Fontsource | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| [IBM Plex Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/IBM+Plex+Mono) (`fonts/`) | via Fontsource | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Everything here is served from this repository so visitors' browsers never contact a third party.
To update a library, replace the file and bump `CACHE` in `sw.js`.
